title: Hath0r Continuous Integration, Calibration, Deployment & Training (CICCCDCT) State Schema
description: Defines the 4-pillar closed-loop runtime state across Continuous Integration, Calibration, Deployment, and Continuous Training.

active_calibration.description: Indicates whether runtime continuous calibration and drift monitoring is enabled.

last_run_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent calibration run.

total_calibration_runs.description: Cumulative count of executed Taguchi and few-shot calibration runs.

last_signature.description: Name of the most recently compiled DSPy signature.

current_parameters.description: Active calibrated runtime parameters applied to agent inference calls.

drift_metrics.description: Measured parameter and behavioral drift relative to baseline benchmarks.

training.description: Continuous Training (CT) state tracking active models, dataset volume, and evaluation scores.

history.description: Chronological log of calibration and training executions.
